description: Presidential Secretariat - Notify the Appointment of a Task  Force  to direct , Co-ordinate and monitor the Development activities in the Northern & Eastern Provinces
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific named individuals (including the President, Prime Minister, and numerous ministers/secretaries) AND detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities and functions (e.g., "Minister of Finance and Mass Media," "Minister of Resettlement, Rehabilitation, Northern Development & Hindu Religious Affairs"). The content establishes a Task Force with both the "who" (government personnel) and "what" (their specific ministerial portfolios and responsibilities), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
